description: Canada's head coach Jesse Marsch says captain Alphonso Davies will be available for the country's FIFA World Cup game against Qatar in Vancouver on Thursday.
title: Canada captain Alphonso Davies will be available to play vs. Qatar on Thursday

description: While investigating allegations of corruption at Calgary city hall, police say they uncovered text messages sent by former councillor Sean Chu to a man now accused of offering money for council votes in which Chu said to “keep conversations to his personal phone” because his work phone was “subject to Freedom of Information” disclosure.
title: Ex-Calgary councillor directed use of personal phone over freedom of information concerns: docs

description: Generational American defender Caroline Harvey is a member of the Vancouver Goldeneyes. The 23-year-old was selected first overall by Vancouver at the 2026 PWHL Draft in Detroit on Wednesday night.
title: Vancouver Goldeneyes pick American Caroline Harvey 1st overall in PWHL draft

description: Israeli operations in the Gaza Strip have killed 1,005 Palestinians since Israel and Hamas reached a ceasefire last October, the Gaza Health Ministry said Wednesday.
title: More than 1,000 Palestinians killed since Israel-Hamas ceasefire, says Gaza Health Ministry

description: Twenty years after then-premier Ralph Klein gave every Albertan a $400 cheque, the current Alberta government is giving each eligible resident a one-time payment of $100.
title: About 3.4 million Albertans will receive $100 energy rebate from provincial government

description: Many Canadian homeowners took advantage of historically low mortgage rates during the pandemic to lock in for five-year terms. Andrew Chang explains the perfect storm happening now as these terms come up for renewal at much higher rates at the same time as a depressed housing market. (Photo credits: The Canadian Press, Reuters, Adobe Stock and Getty Images)
title: Why some homeowners are falling into a mortgage payment trap they can't escape | About That

description: Two men tied to a trucking business in the RM of Edenwold are facing human trafficking charges after a months-long RCMP investigation. Expert are speaking out about the need for education about labour trafficking and how to spot red flags.
title: 'This is happening every day': Experts raise alarm after recent human trafficking arrests in Sask.

description: U.S. President Donald Trump on Wednesday derailed the confirmation process of his own nominee to head the nation's intelligence agencies, an extraordinary move that upended Senate efforts to renew a crucial surveillance program that expired last week and fuelled fresh tensions with fellow Republicans on Capitol Hill.
title: Trump says he'll delay nomination for Clayton to be his next intel chief

description: With only days left before MPs head back to their ridings for the summer, the Liberal government is aiming to pass key pieces of legislation while it can — but the legislative rush has opposition parties crying foul.
title: Opposition parties up in arms as Liberals use majority to speed up legislation before summer

description: The Yellowknife Minor Hockey Association plans an overhaul to its structure, getting rid of female-only development teams, an option for more elite players, in favour of what it's calling a travel team model.
title: Yellowknife hockey players say changes to team structure for girls are offside

description: A Quebec-based RCMP police officer has been arrested for allegedly threatening U.S. President Donald Trump online.
title: Quebec-based RCMP officer charged with uttering threats online toward Donald Trump

description: Christina Aguilera, Stevie Wonder, Jennifer Hudson, John Legend, U2's Bono and the Edge, Eddie Vedder and Bruce Springsteen are among the musicians scheduled to take the stage celebrating the opening of the Obama Presidential Center’s Grand Opening Ceremony in Chicago's South Side.
title: Stevie Wonder, Bruce Springsteen among star-studded list performing at Obama centre's opening

description: Scientists have solved a mystery that puzzled them for decades: Why were so many dead children buried by hunter-gatherers in Russia 5,500 years ago? It turns out they were killed by the earliest known outbreak of the plague, revealing new insights about the disease.
title: Earliest outbreak of the plague killed hunter-gatherer kids 5,500 years ago

description: CBC/Radio-Canada must provide more local coverage in emerging "news deserts," where declining advertising revenue has resulted in the closure of hundreds of outlets in the past two decades, according to a new Senate report on Canada’s public broadcaster.
title: CBC must provide more local coverage, Senate committee urges

description: Tom Holland has apparently confirmed that he and his longtime love Zendaya have tied the knot, ending months of speculation triggered by Zendaya's stylist.
title: Tom Holland confirms he and Zendaya are married

description: Derald Flamand, 64, is one of eight people to survive Saskatchewan's deadliest highway crash. He travelled from B.C. to see a new plaque west of Swift Current, Sask., that details the fiery three-vehicle crash that left 22 young men dead on May 28, 1980.
title: Bus crash survivor forever changed by Sask.'s deadliest highway disaster

description: The U.S. crackdown on drug trafficking on the border with Mexico has triggered an increase in criminal activity coming across the border from Canada, according to Markwayne Mullin, the U.S. secretary of homeland security.
title: Trump's homeland security chief says pressure on Mexican cartels pushing crime to Canadian border

description: A pair of 14-year-old boys in Edmonton have been charged for allegedly using artificial intelligence to create child exploitation images of their classmates.
title: Edmonton teens charged with using AI to create sexually exploitative images of classmates

description: Canada's population dipped by about 55,000 people in the first three months of this year, according to new numbers from Statistics Canada, which on Wednesday set the population at 41,417,056.
title: Canada's population drops in first quarter of 2026

description: Luigi Mangione, the man accused of gunning down a health insurance executive in Manhattan, plans to argue at trial that he was in a state of "extreme emotional disturbance" when he allegedly committed the crime, a judge revealed at a court hearing Wednesday.
title: Luigi Mangione seeks 'extreme emotional disturbance' defence in CEO killing case

description: Employees of Newfoundland and Labrador’s health authority recently received an email titled June Holiday thanking them for their hard work in recent months — only to find out it was all just a cybersecurity test. Now, the NLHS Digital Health Service CEO is apologizing, saying the email was "not sensitive."
title: N.L. health-care workers got an email promising a day off — but it was only a cybersecurity test

description: A proposed class-action lawsuit that says Costco "systematically cheated" customers by advertising its hugely popular Kirkland Signature seasoned rotisserie chicken as containing no preservatives is "fatally flawed" and should be thrown out, lawyers for the company say.
title: Lawsuit against Costco's popular rotisserie chicken 'fatally flawed,' company's lawyers say

description: The Maple Leafs have hired Jim Hiller as the 41st head coach in franchise history. The 57-year-old returns to Toronto after spending four seasons as an assistant coach with the club from 2015-19.
title: Maple Leafs hire Jim Hiller as head coach

description: Iran will immediately take steps to reopen the Strait of Hormuz once a tentative deal with the U.S. to end the war is signed and will be allowed to sell its oil without restrictions, according to leaked copies of an interim agreement that officials say broadly matches the document.
title: Iran-U.S. agreement leaks reveal plans to reopen Strait of Hormuz, 60-day window for nuclear talks

description: A business jet with six people on board crashed on a highway in Laredo, Texas, and caught fire Tuesday night, authorities said, killing one person and causing chaos as people left their vehicles to frantically try to smash the cockpit window and free those inside.
title: 1 killed when small plane crashes on Texas highway. People leave vehicles to help

description: Quebec City police have largely driven the numbers, issuing 11,092 fines in six years. Now Montreal is mulling a bylaw of its own regulating interactions between police and citizens, but advocates say it could exacerbate tensions and police misconduct.
title: Police in Quebec municipalities issued thousands of fines for insulting officers

description: The last stretch of road to the frontlines in the Russia-Ukraine war is often called the kill zone. It’s swarming with drones, littered with burnt-out vehicles, and populated by residents continuing to live their daily lives.
title: Inside Ukraine’s kill zone

description: After nearly 250 days in U.S. Immigration and Customs Enforcement detention, Winnipeg-born Clayton Herman walked free on Monday.
title: Winnipeg-born Canadian released from U.S. immigration detention after 7 months in 'hellhole'

description: With a brilliant hat trick in a 3-0 win over Les Fennecs, Argentina's Lionel Messi moved into a tie with Germany's Miroslav Klose for the career scoring record at the men's World Cup.
title: Lionel Messi ties men's World Cup goals record with a hat trick as Argentina tops Algeria

description: Six pieces of signs advertising for a pharmacy in southwest Nova Scotia were sold at an auction for over $30,000. Auctioneer said the techniques, design and the history they carry made them hot commdity.
title: Rare antique N.S. pharmacy signs auctioned off for $32,500

description: A Hamilton hospital says it has become the first in the world to use an experimental exosome treatment on a burn patient, helping a Western University student recover from severe injuries suffered in a London fraternity house fire.
title: World-first burn treatment helps Western University student recover from injuries suffered in fire
'Major shock': Canadians grapple with loss of CBC's Hockey Night in Canada tradition
What will replace Hockey Night in Canada? Women's sports will 'absolutely' get play: CBC

description: Within weeks of a wildfire, an orange crust coats deadwood and the charred forest floor, creating an otherworldly landscape that still seems to be smoking. But instead of continued destruction, it’s a signal of rebirth: tiny fungi are colonizing the wreckage.
title: As wildfires grow, tiny fire-loving fungi could hold the key to a landscape’s recovery

description: Prominent tech businesses pushing to use AI intensively have been stung by sky high AI costs, especially for agentic chain-of-thought purposes. Now, they're looking at getting beyond experimentation to tokenomics: really breaking down the return on investment for big AI spending.
title: Companies question cost of AI as tokenmaxxing spending adds up

description: Canada also faces a record-low fertility rate, and experts are looking to South Korea to see what they're doing right after years of plummeting birthrates.
title: Matchmaking and cash: South Korea's plan to avoid population decline

description: Politicians are condemning a white nationalist group’s visits to northern Ontario, saying their presence is not welcome — a sentiment echoed in some other communities where Second Sons Canada members have been seen in recent months.
title: No place for 'hate' or 'divisiveness': Politicians condemn white nationalist group's visit to northern Ontario
